description: This source file implements the PipelineRunner class responsible for managing the execution lifecycle of pipeline tasks, including signal handling, garbage collection, task scheduling, and cleanup within an asynchronous asyncio environment.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: A class that manages the execution of pipeline tasks, including handling signals for interruption, optional garbage collection, and cleanup in an asyncio event-driven context.

methods.description: Initializes the PipelineRunner with configuration options for signal handling, garbage collection, and event loop.

methods.name: run(self, task: PipelineTask)
methods.description: Executes a given pipeline task asynchronously until completion, handling cleanup and optional garbage collection.

methods.name: stop_when_done(self)
methods.description: Schedules all current tasks to stop when their processing completes.

methods.name: _cancel(self)
methods.description: Internal method to cancel all tasks concurrently.

methods.name: _setup_sigint(self)
methods.description: Sets up handling for SIGINT signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _setup_sigterm(self)
methods.description: Sets up handling for SIGTERM signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: _sig_handler(self)
methods.description: Signal handler that initiates task cancellation upon receiving a signal.

methods.name: _sig_cancel(self)
methods.description: Performs the cancellation of tasks when interrupted by a signal.

methods.name: _gc_collect(self)
methods.description: Forces garbage collection and logs the number of objects collected and remaining.
